correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the cleared coefficients and independently checked the discriminants and stationary resultant by bounded modular Sylvester determinants with enough distinct evaluation points and total modulus for exact equality. Recomputed all 33 positive certificate coefficients and the critical radical evaluations; the 7-by-7 determinant for the cubic and J is exactly 847872+494592 sqrt(3), hence nonzero. The quartic discriminant is negative, and opposite signs of constant and leading coefficients fix the signs of the two real roots. For a tending to 0, the limit 24 puts no roots in any fixed disk; near 1 the limit 24z puts just one root in a fixed disk, identifiable as the negative real root by the signs at 0 and at any fixed small negative z. Thus both relevant moduli diverge at both ends and have interior minima. The stationary resultant and strict positivity isolate a=2-sqrt(3) uniquely for the positive root, where it is 2+sqrt(3). Logarithmic differentiation of Vieta and J nonvanishing rules out this parameter for any minimizer of the conjugate modulus. In degrees two and three, the discriminants and signs give respectively one remaining positive root or a conjugate pair of equal moduli after excluding the negative root. No precise minimizing parameter or uniqueness for the pair is claimed. Recipe and exact outputs: /workspace/branches/independent-math.md, section 5.
